fact: The Rwanda Statistical Year Book 2024 by NISR compiles statistics from administrative records, with table sources naming the Ministry of Education school census, R-HMIS and RBC health data, RSSB (social security), Rwanda National Police, Rwanda Investigation Bureau, Supreme Court, RRA, NAEB, RURA, REG, WASAC and RDB; it is the 2024 edition, a year before the 2025 edition.
title: Rwanda Statistical Year Book 2024
publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
